content: Global central bank easing cycle broadening. US M2 money supply growth turned positive at +3.2% YoY, historically leading Bitcoin cyclical appreciation by 90 days.
US Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded net inflows of $420M over the past 48 hours. OTC desk balances dropped to multi-month lows as institutional custodians continue net accumulation.
Bipartisan crypto market structure regulatory framework advances in US Senate committee with favorable clarity for spot and derivative trading venues.
Crypto Fear & Greed index reaches 66 (Greed). Perpetual futures funding rate neutral at 0.009% per 8h, showing leverage remains balanced without over-extension.
BTC confirmed breakout above the $64,500 range resistance on above-average spot volume. Daily 50/200 EMA golden cross firmly intact with initial target at $68,200.
